title: Majority disagreement and the disagreement region
statement: Let $n$ be odd, and let $x,y\in\{-1,1\}^n$. Form the point in the plane whose coordinates are the respective sums of the signs in $x$ and $y$, each divided by $\sqrt n$. This point has coordinates with negative product if and only if the majorities of $x$ and $y$ differ, where the majority sign is positive when the sum of signs is nonnegative and negative otherwise.
